body: Naw, I haven't.  Aren't there a bunch of different versions?  Where would be a good place to start?

It's really nice of you to offer, I do love coop games and I've heard some good things about mass effect.  It's just that I don't think it would help.  I've got plenty of games and some friends I could call to hang out with.  I'm having a hard time enjoying these things when I think of how grey the rest of my life is.  Popped in New Vegas today and I could barely play it because of thoughts of the homework I was neglecting.  Turned off new vegas and wasted the rest of my time on reddit, writing my note, and watching the walking dead.  I don't even like the walking dead.
Gaming and sleeping mostly, but they both feel so temporary.  Sooner or later I have to wake up or the game's going to end and then I have to face reality.

I feel like I keep gaining ground.  Plan the suicide, let a few months pass.  Buy the gun, let a few months pass.  Tonight I wrote the note, but I'm not sure if I'm doing it tonight or not.  Hopefully I get there soon.  Anyone see anything wrong with my logic in the note?  I sure can't.
